untested: 2022.3 LTS (below package minimum; not certified by this contract)

platforms.notes: Uses IDFV (ifv). IDFA is not returned by this SDK version.
Prefers GAID (ga), then App Set ID (asid), then Android ID (aid). Play Services may be required when auto GAID/App Set ID collection is enabled.
Editor is supported for configuration, token verify, and debug overlay. Device identity and production readiness require a player build on a supported platform.

notes: package.json unity field is the minimum Unity version for UPM resolution.
Store submission / signed attestation workflows are Phase 3 (GEE-528) and out of scope for this contract.
Backend analysis-readiness is authoritative (GEE-525); this contract only proves local integration attestation.

steps: Click + > Add package from git URL...
Click Add and wait for dependency resolution
Use only when explicitly directed to track main
Prefer a tagged version for agent-verifiable installs
Download or clone the repository at tag/version 1.1.9
Place the package contents under Packages/com.geeklab.audiencelab-sdk
Reload the Unity project and confirm Package Manager shows Audiencelab SDK 1.1.9

postInstallChecks: Package Manager lists com.geeklab.audiencelab-sdk at version 1.1.9
Assemblies geeklab.audiencelab-sdk and geeklab.audiencelab-sdk.Editor compile without errors
Menu item Audiencelab SDK/SDK Settings is available
androidBuildRequirements: When GAID or App Set ID auto-collection is enabled, ensure Play Services dependencies resolve via EDM or mainTemplate.gradle
Keep AndroidManifest INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions
AD_ID permission is declared by the SDK AndroidManifest when GAID collection is used
For release obfuscation, add ProGuard keep rule: -keep class com.Geeklab.plugin.** { *; }

applicationApiKey.name: AudienceLab application API token
applicationApiKey.delivery: Obtain via authorized AudienceLab credential handoff for the entitled workspace+app (GEE-481). Prefer short-lived / one-time retrieval into the integration host.
never: Commit the raw key to source control
Write the raw key into ordinary logs, analytics events, or shared audit payloads
Reuse a sandbox key as production proof of readiness
Expose the key through MCP tool results intended for durable transcripts when a one-time handoff is available

storage.sourceControl: Keep consumer project token-bearing assets out of git. See secretsPolicy.consumerGitignore.

editorFlow: Save assets and restart Unity if prompted so Resources settings reload

requiredSettings.purpose: Authenticates the app installation to AudienceLab
Allows signal delivery required for readiness

recommendedSettings.purpose: Editor/Development builds only; inspect webhook and fetch-token results
Keep raw stable identifiers out of logs unless actively debugging identity

publicApis.purpose: Return SDK version string; must equal package version
Return installation creative token after registration succeeds
Wait for identity collection and return preferred hybrid identifier
Runtime consent gate for outbound statistics
Send custom event with JSON-safe properties

consent.model: Integrator-controlled. The SDK does not present a user-facing consent UI. The host app must gate collection using product/legal policy and the SDK toggles below before claiming production readiness.

controls.effect: When false, SDK does not initialize and no signals are sent
When false, webhook and related statistics remain paused; queued events resume when re-enabled
Controls Android advertising ID collection; disable when policy or store rules require it
Controls Android App Set ID auto-collection and associated Play Services dependency generation

collected.notes: Preferred iOS identifier for hybrid Unity + server-side integrations
GAID when auto or manual collection is enabled and available
App Set ID fallback when enabled
Android ID fallback; no Play Services required
Limit-ad-tracking style flag when the platform reports it

notCollected: idfa (not returned by this SDK version)
Raw application API tokens in webhook payloads

loggingRules: Do not log raw application API tokens
Routine identity debug messages must report availability without logging raw stable identifier values unless showRawIdentifiers is explicitly enabled for a local debug session
Audit systems may record credential issuance/use metadata only, never the raw key

minimumForReadiness.acceptance: Editor verify call against /auth succeeds for the intended environment token
Player build obtains a non-empty creative token via /fetch-token (AudiencelabSDK.GetCreativeToken())
At least one accepted webhook event_type=session with payload.a=start is observed for the production (or approved prod-like) app
store-metrics request succeeds; strengthens readiness evidence but is not alone sufficient
When the app monetizes, send at least one purchase or ad event; required by backend policy when those data sources are declared

catalog.notes: a=start|end; end includes reason r and duration sd

catalog.api: AudiencelabSDK.SendPurchaseEvent(id, name, value, currency, status, tr_id?)
AudiencelabSDK.SendAdEvent(ad_id, name, source, watch_time, reward, media_source, channel, value, currency, dedupeKey?)

catalog.notes: properties must be JSON-safe primitives, dictionaries, or lists

editor: Audiencelab SDK > SDK Settings token verification status
Android dependency validation messages in SDK Settings (EDM / Gradle)
runtime: Development Build debug overlay (F8 or five-finger tap) when enableDebugOverlay is true
WebRequestManager request results for fetch-token and webhook event types

checks.description: package.json version, SDKVersion.VERSION, and contract package.version are identical
Recommended git install URL pins the contract package version tag
Required Runtime/Editor/Plugins package files referenced by the contract exist
No consumer token assets are tracked; .gitignore includes secret path patterns
Contract unity.minimum matches package.json unity field

agentPassCriteria: For runtime certification: creative token present and at least one accepted session_start signal in the target environment
runtimeProof: Build a Development player for a supported platform with IsSDKEnabled and SendStatistics true
Confirm overlay or backend health shows accepted session webhook
Do not treat sandbox-only acceptance as production analysis-ready

rollback.packagePinning: Always pin Packages/manifest.json to a git tag (for example #1.1.9). Avoid floating main for production apps.
steps: Change com.geeklab.audiencelab-sdk dependency to the last known-good tag
Delete Library/PackageCache/com.geeklab.audiencelab-sdk* if Unity retains a stale resolve
Re-open Unity, re-verify the API token, and rebuild the player
If Android dependency files were regenerated, re-run EDM resolve or rebuild so Play Services match the rolled-back settings
Confirm GetSDKVersion() matches the rolled-back tag before sending new production traffic
compatibilityNotes: Minor/patch SDK versions in 1.1.x are intended to be additive for public APIs used by this contract
If a contractVersion major changes, agents must re-read the new contract before integrating
Rolling back the package does not rotate credentials; revoke/rotate keys separately through AudienceLab credential APIs when compromise is suspected

outOfScope: Store submission automation and signed build attestations (GEE-528 / Phase 3)
Changing Unity runtime SDK behavior beyond documentation and verification affordances

rules: Application API tokens are secrets and must remain outside source control
Prefer environment/secret-manager injection or local unsynced Unity assets for token storage
Verification evidence must redact token values; only record present/absent and last-4 if explicitly required by a secure host
This repository must not add sample production tokens
